gaps: FY2007-FY2014: no published financial statements. Xiaomi was founded in 2010 and listed in July 2018; the prospectus track record starts at FY2015.
dividendPerShare: null for FY2015, FY2016, FY2017 - pre-IPO; no dividend information
sharesOutstanding: null for FY2015, FY2016, FY2017 - pre-IPO share structure (preferred shares, pre-capitalisation) not comparable
employees: null for FY2015, FY2016, FY2017 - prospectus gives headcount only at 31 March 2018 (14,513), not at year-ends FY2015-2017
notes: IFRS throughout; RMB (CNY), reports in RMB'000.

FY2015-FY2017 from the June 2018 Global Offering prospectus (pre-IPO). Equity attributable to owners was negative in FY2015-2017 because convertible redeemable preferred shares were carried as liabilities at fair value; the FY2017 loss reflects RMB54.1bn fair-value loss on those shares.
totalDebt = 'total borrowings' as stated in the MD&A / prospectus indebtedness section, which the company publishes only rounded to RMB0.1 billion.

capex = 'Capital expenditures' line of the cash flow statement (property and equipment, intangibles and land use rights together; FY2025 line renamed 'Purchase of property, plant and equipment, land use rights and intangible assets').
operatingCashFlow is the statutory cash flow statement figure; the MD&A uses a different measure for some years (e.g. FY2019 RMB9.9bn excluding fintech loan movements).

sharesOutstanding = total issued Class A + Class B ordinary shares per the share capital note table (published in thousands), including shares held by share scheme trusts. Pre-IPO share counts (FY2015-2017) are not comparable and left null.
dividendPerShare = 0 for FY2018-FY2025: each annual report states the Board resolved not to declare any final dividend.
